items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: I think it was Ray Bonitas, Augie Chalang, Myer Wine Boyd, Julian Langan, Shawkey. I think that was about it.

ctx.x: No, I didn't record with them at the Owls.

No, my first records were with Shawkey Banana in 1936 when Shawkey Banana came with them. And we were playing together then. Where is the Shawpery? The Shawpery is now called Maison's Beach House out on Ponchacrine Boulevard. Were the records made in New Orleans? Oh, yes. I made the records with Shawkey at the Roosevelt Hotel. Who was in that band anyway? I think it was Ray Bonitas, Augie Chalang, Myer Wine Boyd, and I was in the band.
And then, I was in the band. Where is the Shawpery?
